overnight face & neck mask

Acively moisturises and smooths the skin. Regenerates and strengthens the epidermis. Soothes irritations and skin redness. Ideal for night skin regeneration and perfect for neck care.

product.label.guide

How to use

Apply a thin layer of mask evenly on cleansed face and neck skin. Avoid eye area. After 10 to 15 minutes gently pat in the unabsorbed mask or rinse off with lukewarm water.

INCI

Aqua (Water), Paraffinum Liquidum (Mineral Oil), Cera Microcristallina (Microcrystalline Wax), Octyldodecanol, Glyceryl Stearate, PEG-100 Stearate, Elaeis Guineensis (Palm) Oil, Glycerin, Cetearyl Alcohol, Myristyl Myristate, Panthenol, Propylene Glycol, Sodium Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Isohexadecane, Polysorbate 80, Beta-Glucan, Euterpe Oleracea Fruit Extract, Tocopheryl Acetate, Hesperidin Methyl Chalcone, Steareth-20, Dipeptide-2, Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7, Sodium Hyaluronate, Dimethicone, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Parfum (Fragrance), Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil, Limonene, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Linalool, Citronellol, Citric Acid.
 
The list of ingredients is consistent with the current state of manufacture as of 2024-04.

MAIN INGREDIENTS

hyaluronic acid, provitamin B5 (D-panthenol), acai berry, beta-glucan, derivative of hesperidin
